description: Lists the freezer: cards whose moment passed and left What needs you by themselves (a reply three days after its thread was posted, a trend once it stopped being current, a post or a newsletter issue three days after its day, an idea once its week ended, a picture with its post). Each with who made it, its line, why it froze, when it went in and when it leaves (30 days after). They are not waiting for the owner and are counted nowhere; freezer_take_out puts one back. Reading spends nothing.
